integrity: All theorems have analytical proofs. Finite exact-arithmetic checks are corroboration, not substitutes for the proofs. No independent audit or independent validation has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Exact result restricted to homogeneous cubic Walsh projections at the \(L^1\) and \(L^\infty\) endpoints on finite Boolean cubes. No assertion for other degrees, other groups or intermediate \(L^p\) norms. An equivalent older formulation may exist.
title: Infinite dimension plateaus for the cubic Walsh Fourier projection
